_comment: Documents for the harvester to retrieve. Written by adjudication agents that need a citation
resolved to bytes; consumed by .github/workflows/harvest.yml, which runs on GitHub's
infrastructure because the build container has no outbound egress.
Each item: id (stable key), url, optional headers, optional note, optional refetch:true to
re-retrieve something already in the ledger.
This starting set is a SMOKE TEST, not research. It is chosen to prove the mechanism and to
distinguish the failure modes from each other: a host needing no key, a host needing a key we
may not have yet, and a host that is expected to work regardless.

items.note: NARA Catalog API v2. Returns 401/403 without NARA_API_KEY in repo secrets - which is itself the useful signal, since it proves egress works and isolates the key as the only missing piece.
GovInfo accepts DEMO_KEY at a low rate limit, so this should succeed with no secret configured at all.
USAspending needs no key. A clean 200 here proves the harvester path end to end.
USGS National Map product query, no key required. The historical topo series is the GEO axis's primary source.
FCC antenna structure registration via Socrata, no key required.
